task: Persist a profile row per Supabase auth user (public.profiles via auth.users trigger, RLS, manual SQL migration) and a zod-validated server helper getCurrentProfile for later Kudos screens
acceptanceCriteria: migration creates public.profiles with RLS enabled, authenticated SELECT only, no client writes, anon revoked
trigger syncs email from auth.users and full_name/avatar_url from the Google identity on sign-in and never touches department
existing auth users are backfilled and the migration is idempotent and transactional
rollback file removes trigger, function, policy and table without touching auth.users
getCurrentProfile reads the signed-in user's row via getClaims (never getSession), validates with zod, and returns null on any failure without throwing
only @sun-asterisk.com accounts can sign in (DB gate, domain-scoped RLS, domain-only backfill, callback check)
blastRadius: Google sign-in (trigger on auth.users can block it)
contracts: Profile type / getCurrentProfile(client?) signature for future Homepage/Kudos consumers
